sanskrit: mahābhuja - ripuskandha - ghṛṣṭacakrāya cakriṇesanatkumāraṃ natvā'tha papracchedaṃ pulastyakaḥmantrarājaṃ yathānyāyaṃ prasādaṃ kuru suvratayasyā'haṃ vaśagā nityaṃ ravirudrāḥ savāsavāḥdivi bhuvyantarikṣe ca viṣṇurityabhidhīyateādau gurumukhāllabdhvā mantraṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥdvijasantarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā prahṛṣṭenā'ntarātmanādevārcanaṃ tathā kṛtvā yāgaṃ kuryād dayānvitaḥaśvatthe sāgarānte vā japet pratisahasrakamṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa saṃpūjya madhusūdanamviṣṇave hṛdayāhvānaṃ mantrarājaṃ niśāmayaoṅkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya trivāraṃ parameśvarampadmajaṃ tanmukhopetaṃ śakrasyopari saṃsthitamtīrthaṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ śriyā mūrdhniṃ vyavasthitamrudraṃ padmasamāyuktaṃ pāvakopari saṃsthitamkhāntaṃ nāntaṃ tathā chāntaṃ dhāntaṃ lāntaṃ caladvayameparam aiparaṃ caiva aparāntaṃ parātrayaṃsvāhā śabdaṃ tato dadyāt sampūrṇaṃ siddhidāyakam|| iti sanatkumārīye prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥdhyānaṃ caiva trikālasya naivedyaṃ ca niśāmayaāsane upaviśyātha guruṃ natvā puṭāñjaliḥjaptvāmantraṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vādināṃ vijayī bhavetkuryād gurūpadeśena laukikānapi deśikaḥpūjādvāre copaviśya pādaprakṣālanaṃ sudhīḥācamya dvāradevāṃstu pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guruṃ natvā gaṇeśaṃ ca vāstupūjāṃ samācaretbhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyā'tha deve'haṃ cintayed budhaḥprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryādaṅganyāsaṃ ca mantravittrailokyarakṣaṇaṃ cakramasurāntakameva cacaturthyantaṃ tu saṃsādhya svāhāśabdamanantaramnamaḥ svāhā svadhā vauṣaṭ vaṣaṭkāraṃ tathāstrakamsvaśaktibhiḥ keśavādyairnyāsaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥtattvanyāsaṃ prakurvīta karanyāsaṃ tathā budhaḥvibhūtipañjaranyāsaṃ yatra yatra daśākṣaramśaṅkhasthāpanakaṃ cāpi kuryād gurupadeśataḥpīṭhaṃ prakalpya dehe sve dharmādīna vai prapūjayetbāhyaṃ mukhyaṃ gṛhasthasya varṇino'ntaḥprapūjanamtasya koṇeṣu dharmādīn tatpārśve pūrvadharmakānkeśareṣu ca pūjā vai vimalādyāśca devatāḥniḥsārya pūjayed devaṃ samāvāhya ca yatnataḥpādyādīṃścaiva yatnena pūjayedākṛtīgaṇānjaptvā mantraṃ ca tantroktaṃ pūjayed devavat svayamvāratrirarghyatoyena tarpayenmantramadhyaketantroktena vidhānena prayogaṃ kurute sudhīḥ|| iti sanatkumāratantre pūjāsūtraṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥhaṃsamantreṇa jīvaṃ vai satattvaṃ kuṇḍalīyutamvāmanāsāpuṭe dhūmraṃ vāyubījaṃ vicintayetdakṣanāsāpuṭe raktaṃ vahnibījaṃ vicintayetkṛtvā taṃ vāmayā secyaṃ ṭhaṃ bījaṃ śuklavarṇakamtena sañjanitaṃ dehaṃ pavitraṃ sumanoharam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: so'haṃ mantreṇa kuṇḍalyā tattvaiśca parivāritamprāṇayāmamatho vakṣye yathāvadavadhārayaīḍayā karṣayed vāyuṃ manoḥ ṣoḍaśamātrayāyenaiva pūrayed vāyuṃ tenaiva recayet punaḥubhayormadhyagaṃ kṛtvā tattanmātrābhidhāraṇammātṛkānyāsakaṃ vakṣye yathāvadavadhārayanasośca gaṇḍayoścaiva oṣṭhayordantayostathāhastayoḥ pādayoścaiva sandhiṣvagre yathāvidhikakārādīn makārāntān varṇān tattadgatān nyasetyādayaścaiva catvāro nyasanīyāḥ prayatnataḥhastapādayuge nābhau vaktrauṣṭhasuviniścayaḥpīṭhanyāsamatho vakṣye yathāvadavadhārayabhāskaraṃ ca gaṇeśānaṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ prapūjayetdharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ nyasatu kramātdharmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ pādāḥ pīṭhagātrāṇi cāpareeṣāṃ svasvakalā nyasyāḥ praṇavākṣarapūrvikāḥātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva canamo bhagavate brūyāt viṣṇave ca padaṃ vadetpīṭhātmane hṛdanto'yaṃ manustavādirīritaḥbrahmīśayostatheśānā nāntargrahā navamī matāicchā jñānaṃ kriyā caiva kāminī kāmadāyinīpīṭhanyāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ cintayediṣṭadevatām|| iti sanatkumāratantre pīṭhayajanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥnavanītaṃ dakṣahaste dadhānaṃ pītavāsasamśaṅkhamantrāmbubhiḥ prokṣya vāmato vahnimaṇḍale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: toyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayet taṃ yathāvidhismared vahnyarkacandrāṇāṃ kalāstāstāṣvanukramāthṛnmantreṇā'bhisampūjya hastābhyāṃ chādayet punaḥastramantreṇa saṃrakṣya kavacenā'vaguṇṭhya cagaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvatitīrthāvāhanamantro'yaṃ proktaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥkiñcidarghyāmbu saṅgṛhya prokṣaṇyambhasi yojayetātmānaṃ yāgavastūni sarvatra prokṣayed guruḥśivādayaśca sampūjyāḥ keśaveṣvaṅgadevatāḥpāśāditryakṣarasyānte haṃso'muṣya padaṃ punaḥamuṣya sarvendriyāṇi bhūyo'muṣyapadaṃ vadetpaścādihāgatya mukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu ṭhadvayamsvāgataṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ nigadedagrato guruḥetacchyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntābhirīritamjātī - lavaṅga - kakkolaistaduktaṃ tantravedibhiḥgandha - puṣpā'kṣata - yava - kuśāmbu - tila - sarṣapaiḥsvadhātmanā tataḥ kuryānmadhuparkaṃ samāhitaḥsvadhātmanā tataḥ kuryādadbhirācamanīyakamdadyād yajñopavītaṃ ca hārādyābharaṇaiḥ sahagandha - candana - karpūra - kālāgurubhirīritamāvṛtīḥ pūjayed bhaktyā yathāvadavadhārayakamalāṃ bhāratīṃ caiva ratiṃ śāntaṃ ca patrataḥśrīvatsaṃ vatsakaṃ caiva vanamālāṃ samarcayetsvabījena tato devaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātsamarcayet tato devaṃ hṛdayādīnanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha devasya nirmālyairviṣvaksenaṃ samarcayetpaścād gobhyaḥ samabhyarcyagrāsaṃ kuryāt suśobhanamnūpurairvanyapuṣpaiśca nānāratnairvibhūṣitamatha ratnaprabhāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ prātaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayetratnapīṭhe samāsīnaṃ kāminīśatamadhyagamdhyāyenmadhyandinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sundaraṃ smaravardhanamtatsarvaṃ svavaśaṃ kṛtvā krīḍayantaṃ mudānvitamyathā madhye tathāratrau cintayet kañjalocanambhaktyā kṛṣṇaṃ samabhyarcya naivedyaṃ ca nivedayettathā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraṃ rātrau dadyāt suśobhanamdharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca labhate japakṛnnaraḥ|| iti sanatkumāratantre caturthaḥ paṭalaḥmantradehaṃ pravakṣyāmi triṣu lokeṣu durlabhamacalāṃ ca labhet lakṣmīṃ kavitvaṃ bhavasammatamidaṃ me hṛdayaṃ guhyaṃ yat praṣṭavyaṃ mahāmunegṛhītasya phalaṃ dātā mantroyadyapyasādhitaḥmantraṃ nyasya gurorvākyaṃ na kadācid vikalpayettataḥ sarveṇa bhāvena guruṃ mantreṇa pūjayettato mantraṃ ca gṛhṇīyāt vastreṇā''cchādya mastakamsarvakarma prakurvīta vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥnāradāya purā proktaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuratandritaḥtato mantraṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yathāvidhi mahāmunebhūmibhāge same śuddhe gomayenopalepiteparaṃ brahmāditaḥ kṛtvā varṇasaṅghaṃ samuddharet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tribhirekārṇavībhūtaṃ svāhāntaṃ mantramuddharetayutaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥsahasraṃ vā'pi puṣpāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ susaṃyataḥdaśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt tasya japasya dviguṇaṃ smṛtamśaṃbhormūlākṣaraṃ hyasya triśaktiścāpyavasthitāetat te kathitaṃ vatsa hṛdayaṃ mantramuttamamevaṃ saṃsādhite mantre sādhitaṃ bhuvanatrayamkarmaṇā manasā vācā kuryād yadabhivāñchitamviṣṇurbrahmā ca rudraśca durgā ca sarvadevatāḥmantramenaṃ samuccārya labhate dviguṇaṃ phalamaṅganyāsakaranyāsau mantrasyā'pyakṣareṇa tusthaṇḍile vā jale vā'pi gopālaṃ pūjayet tadājaṭilaṃ dvibhujaṃ nagnaṃ nīlotpaladalaprabhamdāmnā caivodare baddhaṃ vṛkṣāvudūkhalena cayamalārjunayormadhye drutamāgatya līlayādāmni vāsukimāropya mantreṇā'nena yantritamsamākṛṣya samutpāṭya hasantaṃ yamalārjunauyaśodayā kṛtaṃ kroḍe krandantyā''gatya satvaramevaṃ sañcintya gopālaṃ māyāmayamanāmayamdhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlādikamarpayet|| iti sanatkumārīye pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥgopījanapadasyā'nte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥaṣṭādaśārṇasaṃyukta ukto mantro yathāvidhismaraḥ kṛṣṇāya ṭhadvandvaṃ ṣaḍvarṇo manurīritaḥtādṛśaṃ devakīputraṃ huṁphaṭ - svāhāsamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīmanmukundacaraṇaṃ yadeti śaraṇaṃ tataḥpañcāntako dharāsaṃstho manurbinduvibhūṣitaḥpiṇḍaṃ ratipaterbījaṃ namo bhagavate tataḥgopījanapadasyānte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥgopālāyā'gnijāyāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣara udāhṛtaḥśrīśaktimārāḥ kṛṣṇāya māraḥ saptākṣaraḥ paraḥcakrī vāmanasargau ca manurekākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥekavarṇo manuḥ proktaḥ kāmamantraḥ puroditaḥaṣṭavarṇo manuḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ hṛdayasthitaḥgovindaṃ ṅeyutaṃ caiva ramābījamanantaramdvāviṃśatyakṣaro mantraḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥtrayodaśārṇamantro'yaṃ proktaḥ sarvasamṛddhidaḥmāyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā kāmaṃ jayaṃ dehi padadvayamkāmaṃ piṇḍaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ gopālāya tataḥ paramkāmapiṇḍaṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ svāhāntaḥ praṇavādikaḥ|| iti sanatkumārīye ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥnārado'sya ṛṣiḥ prokto gāyatrīcchanda īritamcatuṣkaraṇavedāddhi netrayugmākṣaraiḥ kramātanyeṣāmapi mantrāṇāṃ ṛṣyādyāḥ pūrvadevatāḥdaśākṣare virāṭ chanda ācakrādyaiśca pañcakamkuryācchuddhamatirdhīmān dhyānamevaṃ jagatpateḥgovindaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ gopakanyāḥ sahasraśaḥpiḍitāḥ kāmabāṇena ciramāśleṣaṇotsukāḥsrastadhammillavasanā madaskhalitabhūṣaṇāvilokayantīrvividhairvibhramairbhāvagarvitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: govindaṃ kalaveṇunādanaparaṃ divyāṅgabhūṣaṃ bhajeanyeṣāṃ lakṣamekaṃ ca daśalakṣaṃ daśārṇakambālagopālamantrāṇāṃ dhyānaṃ śṛṇu yathāvidhinavanītaṃ pāyasaṃ ca dhārayantaṃ karadvayesarpiṣā navanītena dadhnā vā pāyasena vātarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśena viśuddhena jalena vābrāhmaṇān bhojayeccaiva daśāṃśakramayogataḥhomāśaktau japaḥ prokto homasaṅkhyācaturguṇaḥvaiśyānāṃ vasusaṅkhyākameṣāṃ strīṇāmayaṃ vidhiḥvaiśyāśritasya śūdrasya daśasaṅkhyāguṇaḥ smṛtaḥtarpaṇe dviguṇaṃ proktaṃ śaktau ca sarvasādhanam|| iti sanatkumārīye japahomādinirṇayaḥ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥlakṣmīprasūnairjuhuyāt śriyamicchannaninditāmāraṇyaiḥ kusumairviprān jātibhiḥ pṛthivīpatīnśūdrāṃśca vaśayenmantrī trimadhvaktairyathākramāttato bhaktyā śyāmalāṅgaṃ prasannaṃ gokulaśriyamsmṛtvā taṃ tarpayenmantrī dugdhabuddhyā śubhairjalaiḥmālatī kusumairdevamarcayitvā yathāvidhikāśaprasūnairjuhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakamhutvā bilvaphalaiḥ pakvaiḥ śriyamāpnotthaninditāmhutvā jyotiṣmatītailaṃ sahasraṃ bahusaṅkhyayāvidhānenā'munā mantrī mahārogāt pramucyateājyāktadūrvāhomena mucyate mahato bhayātsa bhaved dāsavat tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsādhayedakhilān kāmān sākṣād viṣṇurivā'paraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpateiti stutvā vidhānena pūjayedāvṛtigaṇāndikṣu dāmasudāmau ca vasudāmaśca kiṅkiṇīdakṣiṇakaradhṛtakamalārasapūritamudri tānyakarāḥmittavindhā sulakṣaṇā ṛkṣajā suśīlā tathānandagopaṃ yaśodāṃ ca balabhadraṃ subhadrikāmyathāvidhi imāḥ pūjyā brahmādyāstadanantarambrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavīti caaṣṭamī syānmahālakṣmīḥ proktāḥ syurviśvamātaraḥvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathā'ṅkuśamnaivedyaṃ vidhivad datvā devaṃ dhyātvā japet sudhīḥitaḥ pūrvaṃ padaṃ dattvā prāṇabuddhipadaṃ tataḥsuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā tathāśiśnā ca yat smṛtaṃ caiva yaduktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tathāmāṃ madīyaṃ ca sakalaṃ haraye samyak samarpayetpratyahaṃ pūjayed devaṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥtadaśaktau pañcabhistu pūjā syādupacārakaiḥsnānaṃ vāso bhūṣaṇaṃ ca gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakamgandhādayo naivedyāntā pūjā pañcopacārikānamaskṛtya ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca pañcāṅgaṃ ca vidhānataḥdaṇḍavat praṇipatyā'tha gaṇḍābhyāṃ cibukena casāṣṭāṅgakaḥ praṇāmaḥ syāt hareḥ prītipradāyakaḥkathitaṃ yanna kathitaṃ tat sarvaṃ kramataḥ śṛṇupiṭhasyā'rcanamaṅgadevayajanaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhā tataḥrlabhyante ca visarjanaṃ muraripoḥ pūjākramaḥ kīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti nārāyaṇenaiva sūtraṃ prakathitaṃ purāpulastyavidhinā'nena mayā kṛṣṇa upāsitaḥ|| iti sanatkumārīye pūjāvidhānaṃ nāmā'ṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥtrailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kṛpayā kathaya prabhonārāyaṇena kathitaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe purāatiguhyataraṃ tattvaṃ brahmamantraughavigrahamyad dhṛtvā paṭhanāt pāti mahālakṣmīrjagattrayamtrailokyajananī durgā mahiṣādimahāsurānevamindrādayaḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyuḥśaṭhāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyātṛṣiḥ cchandaśca gāyatrī devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayampraṇavo me śiraḥ pātu namo nārāyaṇāya caklīṃ pāyāt śrautrayugmaṃ caikākṣaraḥ sarvamohanaḥgopījanapadaṃ vallabhāyaṃ svāhāṅanaṃ mamagopījanapadaṃ vallabhāya svāhā bhujadvayamklīṃ kṛṣṇa klīṃ karau pāyāt klīṃ kṛṣṇāya cāṅgajo'vatugopālāyā'gnijāyāntaṃ kukṣiyugmaṃ sadā'vatukṛṣṇagovindakau pātu smarādyau ṅeyutau manuḥpṛṣṭhaṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇa kaṅkālaṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya dviṭhāntakaḥūrū saptākṣaraḥ pātu trayodaśākṣaro'vatubhāyasvāheti pāyuṃ vai klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ daśavarṇakaḥtrayodaśākṣaraḥ pātu jaṅghe cakrāyudhaḥ svayamsarvāṅgaṃ me sadā pātu dvārakānāyako balītārādyā dvādaśārṇo'yaṃ prācyāṃ māṃ sarvadā'vatugadādyudāyudho viṣṇurmāmagnerdiśi rakṣatu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāro namo bhagavate rukmiṇīvallabhāya caklīṃ hṛṣīke padaṃśāya namo māṃ vāruṇe'vatuśrīṃ māyākāmakṛṣṇāya govindāya dviṭho manuḥvāgbhavaṃ kāmakṛṣṇāya hrīṃ govindāya tataḥ paramdvāviṃśatyakṣaro mantro māmaiśānyāṃ sadā'vatunamāmi devakīputraṃ nṛtyarājānamacyutamkāmadevāya vidmahe puṣpabāṇāya dhīmahiiti te kathitaṃ vipra brahmamantraughavigrahambrahneśapramukhā'dhīśanārāyaṇamukhā'cyutamguruṃ praṇamya vidhivat kavacaṃ prapaṭhet tataḥmantreṣu sakaleṣveva deśiko nā'tra saṃśayaḥhavanādīn daśāṃśena kṛtvā tat sādhayed dhruvammantrasiddhirbhavet tasya puraścaryāvidhānataḥpuṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ dattvā mūlenaiva paṭhet sakṛtbhūrje vilikhya gulikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayed yadiaśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni cakalāṃ nārhanti tānyeva sakṛduccāraṇāt tataḥtrailokyaṃ kṣobhayatyeva trailokyavijayī bhavetśatalakṣaprajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥiti sanatkumārīye trailokyamaṅgala nāma navamaḥ paṭalaḥśṛṇu vakṣyāmi viprendra mālā pṛṣṭā tvayā hi yātarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ daśaparvasu sañjapettisro'ṅgulyastriparvāḥ syurmadhyamā caikaparvikākramotkramagatairmālā mātṛkārṇaiḥ sabindukaiḥādikacaṭatapayaśalā ityevaṃ cāṣṭavargāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrākṣa - śaṅkha - padmākṣa - putra - jīvaka - mauktikaiḥkuśapatrairdvādaśa syurgṛhasthasyā'kṣamālikāputrajīvairdaśaguṇaṃ śataśaṅkhaiḥ sahasrakamtadeva sphaṭikaṃ proktaṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyatetulasīkāṣṭhaghaṭitairmālābhirjapamālikāaṣṭottaraśatairmālā pañcāśattūttarādhikaiḥmokṣārthī pañcaviṃśatyā dhanārthī rtriśatā japetmālāsaṅgrathanaṃ vakṣye yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā purāmukhaṃ mukhena saṃyojya pucchaṃ pucchena yojayettriguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya tadeva triguṇaṃ tathāśāntivaśyābhicāreṣu tathaiva māraṇe'pi casarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ raktaṃ sarvepsitapradamphalopacārataḥ kṛṣṇamiṣṭvā tantrānusārataḥmaṇimādāya sūtreṣu grathanaṃ madhyamāgrataḥgrathayitvā puro mālāṃ tataḥ saṃskāramārabhetcandanāgarugandhādyairvāmadevena gharṣayetmantrayet pañcamenaiva pratyekaṃ tu sakṛt skṛtyena pratiṣṭhitā mālā tayaiva tu manuṃ japetsadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥṅentāntapraṇāvādyena namo'ntena kramājjapetkālāya namaḥ kalavikaraṇāya namo balapramathanāyasarvataḥ sarvebhyo namaste rudrarupebhyaḥtanno rudraḥ pracodayātsaṃskṛtyaivaṃ budho mālāṃ tatprāṇāṃstatra yojayetguruṃ sampūjya taddhastāt gṛhṇīyādakṣamālikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅguṣṭhaṃ mokṣadaṃ proktaṃ tarjanī śatrunāśinīkaniṣṭhā''karṣaṇe jñeyā japakarmaṇi siddhidāpuraścaryāṃ tataḥ kuryāt svayameva samāhitaḥsarvāsu dīkṣitenaiva puraścaryāṃ samācarettat sarvaṃ kṛpayā nātha saṅkṣepeṇa prakathyatāmamuko'mukagotro'haṃ mūlamuccārya tatparamdaśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ kuryād daśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tataḥpuraścaraṃamevaṃ hi kariṣye prāgudaṅmukhaḥmantraṃ ca prātarārambhya japenmadhyandināvadhiathavā'nyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatenadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātrodake sthitaḥdṛṣṭvā snātvā tu saṅkalpapya vimokṣāntaṃ japaṃ caretiti jāpānmantrasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥsa bhaved devatādrohī pitṝn sapta nayatyadhaḥkṛṣṇabhaktasya suddhyarthaṃ yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā purāpūrṇīmāpratipatsandhau phalgunyāṃ phālgune muneaśvamedhasahasrasya bājapeyaśatasya cadakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dolamānañca sannaraḥdolārūḍhasya kṛṣṇasya ye'gre kurvanti jāgaramtato vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi yatra yattu samācarettrayodaśākṣareṇaiva aṣṭādaśākṣareṇa vāutthāya mantraṃ japtavyamaṣṭādhikasahasrakamrevatyāṃ tu vāstubaliṃ maṇḍalaṃ racayet sudhīḥgovindaṃ phalakādhastād dolārūḍhaṃ jagatpatimṛgyayuḥsāmasūktaiśca mantraiḥ paurāṇikastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadguṇotkīrtanaṃ caiva divārātriṃ nayed budhaḥaparādhasahasraistairmuktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥbrahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhinirṇayamtṛṇaistṛṇadhvajaiścaiva mandiraṃ nirmitaṃ śuciḥkoṭyabdaśatasaṅkhyāni viṣṇuloke bhaveddhruvamyugānāmayutaṃ tatra nivaset satyamīritamtatrānusaṅkhyakān kalpān viṣṇuloke vaset sadāpradadyāt vidhivad bhaktyā proktaṃ śataguṇaṃ tataḥmokṣapradāya kṛṣṇāya kramaśaḥ kathyāṃ prabhouktavarṇeṣu gandhādyairmūlapāriṣadānvitānvajrādīna tantrakumbheṣu gandhādyaistatkramād yajettatribhāgamite kṣetre'ratnimātrasamunnatāmpradhānamandire cāpi sarvatobhadramaṇḍalamjayaṃ ca vijayaṃ caiva vighneśaṃ kṣetranāyakampūrvadikkramato yugmaṃ kramśo gandhapūrvakaiḥtato gṛhaṃ praviśyā'tha vāstvīśamajamarcayetnirasya vighnān tatraiva baddhapadmāsano bhavetarghyapātraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā maṇḍale pīṭhamarcayetgṛtpadme devamārādhya gandhādyairmānasairyajetmūrtau tasyāṃ sasāropya tat tejomūlamantrataḥmāyāpāśāṅkuśādyantā yādīn saptasabindukāntasya prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ punarjīva iha sthitaḥtasyāpi vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇapadānyathakarakacchapikāṃ kṛtvā tato dhyāyedananyadhīḥśrīvatsāṅkamudārakaustubhadharaṃ vande munīndraiḥ stutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tārohṛdbhagavān ḍento vāsudevāya tatparammanunā'nena tatsarvānāsanādīn pradāpayetmadhuparkā''camanaṃsnānaṃ vasanā''bharaṇāni capradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāro visargaścaiva ṣoḍaśaabhyarcya juhuyād vanhau saṃskṛte pūrvavartmanāpunaryajed devatāgre tataḥ pāriṣadān yajetśāntyādiśaktisahitaiḥ parā dvādaśamūrtibhiḥevaṃ sampūjito viṣṇuḥ prasīdatyeva satvaramcaturvarṇaiḥ śikhā proktā pañcārṇaiḥ kavacaṃ matamvāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścā'niruddhakaḥtataśca mandiraṃ dadyānmanunā'nena mānavaḥkṛtvaivaṃ kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥmantrairāgamikaiścaiva vaiṣṇavaiḥ kīrtayeddhāmdattvā ca manunā'nena prāṇāyāmaṃ tataścaretgāyatryā mūlamantreṇa svāhāntena dvijottamaḥṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā bhojayecca dvijottamānvaiśyaśca pādajaścaiva sarve'pyatrā'dhikāriṇaḥ|| iti sanatkumārīye mālānirṇayo nāma daśamaḥ paṭalaḥkriyāvatī kalāvatī varṇātmā vedamapyapipitṛmātṛkṛtaṃ nāma tyaktāyurvarṇavarṇakānāṣāḍho nindito jyeṣṭhaḥ pauṣo bhādrapadastathāpuruṣārthasamāvāptyai sa śiṣyo gurumāśrayetsarvāgamānāṃ sārajñaḥ sarvaśāstrārthatattvavitamoghavacanaḥ śānto vedavedāṅgapāragaḥityādiguṇasampanno gururbhavati mānavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00530 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhītavedaḥ kuśalo dūramuktamanobhavaḥsvadharmanirato nityaṃ pitṛmātṛhite rataḥebhireva guṇairyuktaḥ śiṣyo bhavati nā'paraḥdināni tāni viprendra sāvadhānā'vadhārayajyeṣṭhe ca daśamī kṛṣṇā cā''ṣāḍhe nāgapañcamīāśvine ca mahāpuṇyā mahāṣṭamyapayabhīṣṭadāṣaṣṭhī caturdaśī pauṣe māghe'pyekādaśī sitāpraśastāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ siddhidāḥ śrūyatām budhaḥtrayodaśī tu daśamī praśastā sarvakarmaṇiaśvinī śravaṇā''rdrā ca revatī cottarātrayamatha yogaṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāya caśivātmanorabhedena pratipattiṃ pare viduḥvadanti viṣamānetān viṣamaṃ durgamātmanaḥmadhyamā kumbhayed vāyuṃ vidyayā mātrayā śanaiḥprāṇāyāmamidaṃ prāhuryogaśāstraviśāradāḥsanatkumāratantraṃ tat sambhūtaṃ munipuṅgavātyaḥ paṭhecchuṇuyād vā'pi so'pi puṇyavatāṃ varaḥlakṣmīstasya gṛhaṃ sākṣāt trisandhyaṃ na vimuñcatiśrīgopālapūjāprayogavidhānaṃ nāmaikadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
